events.name: Mehndi Ceremony
events.description: Macro editorial photograph of South Indian bride hands adorned with intricate dark-brown henna, ivory and gold silk cushion, brass katori bowls, marigold petals and jasmine buds in warm afternoon sunlight.

events.name: Haldi Ceremony
events.description: Vibrant sunlit morning courtyard photograph of hammered brass Urli platter with freshly ground turmeric paste, silver sandalwood cup, marigold garlands, and banana leaves.

events.name: Sacred Wedding Ceremony
events.description: Sacred South Indian traditional wedding Mandap with carved wooden pillars, jasmine garlands, glowing brass Nilavilakku oil lamps, and a temple Gopuram silhouette in morning light.

events.name: Grand Wedding Reception
events.description: Luxury champagne-gold and ivory arched reception stage decorated with ivory roses, champagne orchids, hydrangeas, hanging crystals, and glowing brass lamps.
